cases.question: How many hours of sleep are recommended for adults?
cases.answer:
Adults aged 18-60 should aim for 7 or more hours of sleep per night [CDC_008, Page 1]
Adults aged 61-64 should aim for 7 to 9 hours of sleep per night [CDC_008, Page 1]
Adults aged 65 and older should aim for 7 to 8 hours of sleep per night [CDC_008, Page 1]

cases.question: What are some effects of long-term stress?
cases.answer:
Worsening health problems [CDC_009, Page 1]
Trouble concentrating and making decisions [CDC_009, Page 1]
Problems sleeping [CDC_009, Page 1]
Worsening of chronic health problems [CDC_009, Page 1]
Mental health conditions [CDC_009, Page 1]

cases.question: What experiences may occur with anxiety disorders?
cases.answer:
Trouble concentrating or making decisions [WHO_002, Page 2]
Feeling irritable [WHO_002, Page 2]
Tense or restless [WHO_002, Page 2]
Trouble sleeping [WHO_002, Page 2]
Heart palpitations [WHO_002, Page 2]

cases.question: How can relationships support mental wellbeing?
cases.answer:
Good relationships contribute to mental wellbeing by fostering a sense of belonging and self-worth [NHS_004, Page 1]
They offer emotional support and enable sharing of positive experiences [NHS_004, Page 1]

cases.question: How can depression affect everyday activities?
cases.answer: Depression can severely impact daily activities [NIMH_005, Page 1]
